market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC is around $77,700 on April 27, 2026, requiring a ~42% drawdown to hit $45k by Dec 31, 2026 (about 8 months). While BTC has historically had >50% drawdowns, doing so within 8 months requires a sustained bear market. April performance is +13.7%, indicating strength, not weakness. Probability is low but not negligible given crypto volatility.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether macro shock or risk-off event triggers a 40%+ drawdown in remaining 8 months.
